Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    microchip_id = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    birth_date = Column(Date)\n    gender = Column(String)\n    description = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass AdoptionApplication(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"adoption_applications\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    application_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\"), nullable=False)\n    applicant_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Submitted\")\n    adoption_fee = Column(Float)\n    submitted_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass HomeCheck(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"home_checks\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    adoption_application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"adoption_applications.id\"), unique=True, nullable=False)\n    completed_date = Column(Date)\n    notes = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Payment(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"payments\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    adoption_application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"adoption_applications.id\"), nullable=False)\n    amount = Column(Float, nullable=False)\n    payment_method = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    payment_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Pending\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime,       "content": "from pydantic import BaseModel, Field\nfrom typing import Optional\nfrom datetime import date, datetime\n\n\nclass HomeCheckOut(BaseModel):\n    completed_date: date | None = None\n    notes: str | None = None\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }\n\nclass PaymentOut(BaseModel):\n    amount: float\n    payment_method: str\n    payment_date: date\n    status: str\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }\n\nclass AdoptionApplicationOut(BaseModel):\n    application_number: str\n    status: str\n    adoption_fee: float | None = None\n    home_check: HomeCheckOut\n    payment: PaymentOut\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }\n\nclass AdoptionApplicationUpdateIn(BaseModel):\n    status: str = Field(..., example=\"Approved\")\n    home_check_completed_date: date = Field(..., example=\"2025-03-15\")\n    home_check_notes: str = Field(..., example=\"Yard secure; landlord approval confirmed\")\n    adoption_fee: float = Field(..., example=175.0)\n    payment_amount: float = Field(..., example=175.0)\n    payment_method: str = Field(..., example=\"Credit Card\")\n    payment_date: date = Field(..., example=\"2025-03-18\")"

      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Depends\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import AdoptionApplication, HomeCheck, Payment\nfrom schemas import AdoptionApplicationUpdateIn, AdoptionApplicationOut\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"AdoptionApplications\"])\n\n\n@router.patch(\n    \"/api/adoption_applications/{application_number}\",\n    operation_id=\"update_adoption_application_approval\",\n    response_model=AdoptionApplicationOut,\n)\nasync def update_adoption_application_approval(\n    application_number: str,\n    payload: AdoptionApplicationUpdateIn,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    try:\n        # Find the adoption application by application_number\n        adoption_app = (\n            db.query(AdoptionApplication)\n            .filter(AdoptionApplication.application_number == application_number)\n            .first()\n        )\n\n        if not adoption_app:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Adoption application not found\")\n\n        # Validate status is 'Approved'\n        if payload.status != \"Approved\":\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Status must be 'Approved'\")\n\n        # Update adoption application\n        adoption_app.status = payload.status\n        adoption_app.adoption_fee = payload.adoption_fee\n        adoption_app.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n\n        # Get or create home check\n        home_check = (\n            db.query(HomeCheck)\n            .filter(HomeCheck.adoption_application_id == adoption_app.id)\n            .first()\n        )\n\n        if not home_check:\n            home_check = HomeCheck(\n                adoption_application_id=adoption_app.id,\n                completed_date=payload.home_check_completed_date,\n                notes=payload.home_check_notes,\n                created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n                updated_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            )\n            db.add(home_check)\n        else:\n            home_check.completed_date = payload.home_check_completed_date\n            home_check.notes = payload.home_check_notes\n            home_check.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n\n        # Create payment\n        payment = Payment(\n            adoption_application_id=adoption_app.id,\n            amount=payload.payment_amount,\n            payment_method=payload.payment_method,\n            payment_date=payload.payment_date,\n            status=\"Paid\",\n            created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            updated_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n        )\n        db.add(payment)\n\n        db.commit()\n        db.refresh(adoption_app)\n        db.refresh(home_check)\n        db.refresh(payment)\n\n        return AdoptionApplicationOut(\n            application_number=adoption_app.application_number,\n            status=adoption_app.status,\n            adoption_fee=adoption_app.adoption_fee,\n            home_check=HomeCheckOut(\n                completed_date=home_check.completed_date,\n                notes=home_check.notes,\n            ),\n            payment=PaymentOut(\n                amount=payment.amount,\n                payment_method=payment.payment_method,\n                payment_date=payment.payment_date,\n                status=payment.status,\n            ),\n        )\n\n    except IntegrityError:\n        db.rollback()\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Data integrity error occurred\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        db.rollback()\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f\"An unexpected error occurred: {str(e)}\")\n    finally:\n        db.close()"
    }
